info.title: LazyEdit private Studio API
info.description: One configured owner pilot. See handoff for device-code errors and limitations. No implicit publication.

get.summary: List subtitle targets, independently of UI and ASR languages
get.description: Requires media.read. Check capabilities.subtitleLanguageCatalogue before using this extension. Returns code, name, grammarColors, reading, rtl and requiresPreview, plus renderingWarning where applicable. A registered target is not certification of provider quality or font/shaping coverage. RTL token order needs preview review; specialized readings apply to the exact advertised canonical targets.

200.description: Common subtitle-language catalogue

401.description: Authentication required

post.summary: Validate additional subtitle language tags without saving settings
post.description: Requires media.read. Supports known CLDR language/script/region tags, such as pt-BR, sr-Latn, fil and eo. Preserves requested order, canonicalizes aliases and deduplicates. Unsafe or unknown tags fail instead of reverting to defaults. This does not register an account, start editing or publish.

200.description: Canonical codes and language descriptors

400.description: Unknown, unsafe or invalid language selection

get.summary: Read the original private editing operation and recovery state
get.description: Requires jobs.read, media.read and ownership of the operation/media. operationId is returned as operation_id from preparation acceptance. An accepted receipt is not completion. A restarted worker reports interrupted when an accepted editing task lost its live pipeline; unknown dispatches report reconciliation_required. Check authenticated capabilities.preparationRecovery before using this extension.

200.description: Original operation identity, state, recoverable flag, recovery count and private pipeline status

401.description: Authentication required

403.description: Required scope or media ownership denied

post.summary: Resume an interrupted editing preparation, never a social publication
post.description: Requires edit.submit and media.read for the original owner/media. Send an empty object. Original settings, request identity, source SHA and publication-session identity are retained; completed checkpoints from this operation are reused. It does not create another intent, charge another processing run, upload, publish or select an owner worker. Any prior social job, changed source, superseding operation or uncertain dispatch blocks recovery. An already running/done operation returns its state without redispatch. This API is advertised only by recovery-capable deployments.

200.description: Same editing operation resumed or already working/done

401.description: Authentication required

403.description: Required scope or source ownership denied

409.description: Source, operation, publication or dispatch state needs reconciliation

get.summary: Owned render, cover and zh/en/ja metadata snapshot
get.description: Requires media.read and publication.prepare. Returns studio_review.v1 with videoId, artifact, metadata, cover (media_url/byteLength/sha256), and reviewDigest. Send that digest as reviewedReviewDigest when publishing. It detects changed review material at submission, not an immutable queue snapshot.

200.description: Review snapshot

401.description: Authentication required

409.description: Render, cover or metadata incomplete

200.description: Success (completion is distinct from job acceptance)

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked user credential

409.description: Offset, idempotency or reviewed artifact conflict

Process.description: Use either legacy process options or only preparationPreset/background/requirements. lightmind-capture.v1 prepares the full corrected EN/JA/ZH-Hant/FR, zero-lift, source-aware portrait-fill output with the configured logo. It never rotates or publishes. Text fields have an 8000-character limit. Existing publication jobs block new preset preparation.
